## Highlights

- Keeps the usage indicator attached to the Codex Desktop main window when companion tool windows, including the Codex pet, wake or appear.
- Stabilizes indicator sizing and placement when Codex Desktop moves between monitors with different DPI scaling.
- Shows the `Ctrl+Alt+U` display-toggle shortcut in `usage-indicator help`.

## Documentation and support

- Expands installation, first-run, update, troubleshooting, security, and contribution guidance.
- Adds structured bug-report and feature-request forms for safer, more actionable reports.

[Compare `v0.1.0...v0.2.0`](https://github.com/mursyidd/usage-indicator-for-codex/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0)
